Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this
call?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.
A: I was driving on the main road in Baytown, Texas, in the right lane. I needed to move over to the left lane because I
was approaching my exit.
Q: What did you do before you changed lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I saw a car in the lane next to me, but it looked far enough
back that I thought I had time to move over.
Q: What happened next?
A: As I started to move, the other vehcile came up quickly and sideswiped the passenger side of my car. I felt a hard
jolt and heard metal scraping. I steered back into my lane and pulled onto the shoulder.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My right knee hit the steering column and dashboard area. It's swollen and painful, and I have trouble putting
weight on it.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or gone to an emergency room?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist for
further evaluation.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I was driving carefully and signaling before I moved over. I just want to make sure my side of things is on
record.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
